title: Does a support diagnostic integrated over a target law reconstructed from published marginals still find the analyses that fail?
question: When the target population is known only through published means and SDs, does a support diagnostic for G-computation integrated over the reconstructed law discriminate failed analyses as well as the same diagnostic integrated over the true law, and should it be aggregated as a mean or as a tail functional?
design: Source trial truncated on the sum of two covariates, so unsupported target mass depends on a correlation the publication omits; linear or bent modification; linear G-computation; hull, Mahalanobis, extrapolated-modification and prediction-variance diagnostics integrated over the true law and over the independence reconstruction, scored against interval failure. 12 cells, 1000 replicates each.
